name: Backwater Escape
summary: Three unhurried days on the Alleppey backwaters with an overnight kettuvallam cruise.

itinerary.title: Arrive Alleppey
itinerary.detail: Pickup, settle in, and an evening walk along the canals. Dinner at a local toddy-shop kitchen.

itinerary.title: Overnight houseboat
itinerary.detail: Board the kettuvallam mid-morning. Cruise the village backwaters, lunch onboard, sunset on the deck, dinner and a night on the water.

itinerary.title: Kumarakom & depart
itinerary.detail: Morning at the Kumarakom bird sanctuary, a slow breakfast, and drop-off.

name: Munnar Mist
summary: Four days in the tea hills — sunrise ridges, Eravikulam, and the estate roads.

itinerary.title: Arrive Munnar
itinerary.detail: Drive up through the estates. Evening at a viewpoint as the mist rolls in.

itinerary.title: Kolukkumalai sunrise
itinerary.detail: Pre-dawn jeep to Kolukkumalai for sunrise above the clouds, then the tea museum and estate walk.

itinerary.title: Eravikulam & Top Station
itinerary.detail: Eravikulam National Park in the morning, Top Station and Echo Point in the afternoon.

itinerary.title: Slow morning & depart
itinerary.detail: A relaxed estate breakfast, last photos, and drop-off.

name: Full 360° Kerala
summary: The complete loop — tea hills, backwaters and an offbeat trail day, end to end.

itinerary.title: Arrive Munnar
itinerary.detail: Drive up into the tea country. Evening viewpoint and a settling-in dinner.

itinerary.title: Tea hills
itinerary.detail: Sunrise ridge, Eravikulam, estate walk and the museum.

itinerary.title: Offbeat trail day
itinerary.detail: Bike or jeep route to hidden waterfalls and quiet viewpoints, guided by a local rider.

itinerary.title: Munnar to Alleppey
itinerary.detail: Scenic descent to the coast, arrive by the backwaters for the evening.

itinerary.title: Overnight houseboat
itinerary.detail: Board the kettuvallam, cruise the village backwaters, and spend the night on the water.

itinerary.title: Kumarakom & depart
itinerary.detail: Morning at Kumarakom, a slow breakfast, and drop-off.
